name: go
description: trailbeamsqs (Go): trailbeamsqs.AppendMiddlewares(&cfg.APIOptions) on an aws-sdk-go-v2 config, alone, beside otelaws (also with the application's sampler at 0) and beside dd-trace-go v2. The setup builds the driver with the go on PATH (Go 1.26 or later: the driver takes the newest SDK and instrumentations).

variants.name: alone
variants.about: only Trailbeam: its middleware on the config, no other tracing

variants.name: otelaws
variants.about: beside the application's own tracer provider and the stock otelaws middleware, appended after Trailbeam's: every Trailbeam span is a child of otelaws's exported span for the same call

variants.name: otelaws-sampled-0
variants.about: as otelaws, with the application's sampler at 0: Trailbeam's always-on provider must still export every span, each still a child of otelaws's (unexported) span

variants.name: dd-trace-go
variants.about: beside dd-trace-go v2's aws-sdk-go-v2 middleware (no Datadog agent running: its spans go nowhere). Its span lives in the context as a Datadog span, not an OpenTelemetry one, and it puts no trace header on the request, so Trailbeam's spans are roots here
